title: DVB-S2 Symbol Modulator
text: Modulate data bits to complex constellation symbols according to DVB-S2 standard, 5 inputs, 2 outputs, {Code rate} sets Code rate; {Modulation source} sets the source for modulation, {Modulation}, {Unit average power} sets the spectral growth reduction, {Output data type} and {Word length}. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: data
ports.summary: Data bits Boolean scalar | real scalar

ports.name: valid
ports.summary: Indication of whether input data is valid 0 | 1

ports.name: data
ports.summary: Modulated constellation data symbols complex scalar

params.name: Modulation source
params.values: Source for modulation type Property (default) | Input port

params.values: Output data type Custom (default) | double | single

params.name: Word length
params.values: Word length 16 (default) | integer in the range [3, 32]
